PRIZES AND ODDS

During the hourly drawing1, one number2 between 1 and 38 is drawn. Prizes and odds3 vary depending on Bet Type selected.

Bet Type	Prize	Odds*
Lucky Number	$50	1 in 38
Odd/Even	$3	1 in 2
Low/High	$3	1 in 2

DISCLAIMERS:

Prizes and odds chart based on a $2 wager.

Overall odds of winning a prize vary upon the bet type selected.

1 Pick Your Bet can be played from 4:00 AM to 11:59 PM Arizona time, seven days a week, with the first draw time at 4:40 AM and the last drawing at 11:40 PM Arizona time.

2 Lottery numbers broadcasted on television or radio, published on the Arizona State Lottery website, or published and/or communicated by other means does not constitute an official representation of the actual winning lottery numbers. The Arizona State Lottery official audited records of numbers drawn will determine the winning numbers for any draw. A draw game prize must be claimed within 180 days of a drawing.

3 All sales are final. Drawing game tickets cannot be voided.

howToPlay:
HOW TO PLAY
PICK YOUR BET
Step 1,
Pick Your Bet Type

Choose or Quick Pick from three bet options:

Select a Lucky Number between 1 and 38

Select Odd or Even

Select Low (1 - 19) or High (20 - 38)

Step 2,
Buy Your Ticket

Select your wager - $2, $4, $6, $10, or $20 per play. You also have the option to add Super Bonus to multiply your prize up to 5X. Your ticket will print with your bet on it.

Quick Draw tickets can be purchased at more than 3,000 Arizona Lottery Retailers.

Step 3,
Check Your Winnings

After the drawing occurs, match your bet on your ticket to the results from the drawing to win.
